strategies.name: Crown Regis
strategies.description: Its lucky dial (1033843) has landed a perfect six before — full board, fresh spin every round.

strategies.name: Crown Imperator
strategies.description: An emperor's dial (1209615): the full board spins and six balls answer.

strategies.name: Crown Valerian
strategies.description: Steady as its dial (333155) — the full board turns, six stay crowned.

strategies.name: Crown Constantine
strategies.description: True to one dial (430349): the full board, six balls, every draw.

strategies.name: Crown Astra
strategies.description: A perfect six on its record; its lucky dial (534156) keeps spinning over the full board.

strategies.name: Comet
strategies.description: A fresh spin of its lucky dial (11145) over the balls the previous draw did not touch.

strategies.name: Nova
strategies.description: After parking the previous draw's seven balls, its lucky dial (10677) points to the six it plays.

strategies.name: Vega
strategies.description: Plays six balls its lucky dial (6436) picks from everything the previous draw missed.

strategies.name: Sirius
strategies.description: Its lucky dial (4756) chooses six from the 43 balls the previous draw left behind.

strategies.name: Eclipse
strategies.description: Sets aside the previous draw's seven balls, then its lucky dial (928) picks six of the survivors.

strategies.name: Hunter Longinus
strategies.description: One fixed spin of its lucky dial (742996) over the whole board decides the line.

strategies.name: Hunter Trident
strategies.description: Spins its lucky dial (756885) across the full 1–49 board and plays the six it points to.

strategies.name: Hunter Mjolnir
strategies.description: Brings the same lucky dial (824842) down on the full board every single draw.

strategies.name: Hunter Gungnir
strategies.description: Its lucky dial (1357203) shows up every round: full board in, six balls out.

strategies.name: Hunter Balmung
strategies.description: Reads the full 1–49 board through its own lucky dial (837872) and plays six.

strategies.name: Hunter Gram
strategies.description: A fixed lucky dial (392238) turns over the full board once per draw and picks six.

strategies.name: Hunter Kusanagi
strategies.description: Its lucky dial (549982) sweeps the entire board and plays whatever six it rests on.

strategies.name: Hunter Zulfiqar
strategies.description: The full 1–49 board is its field; its lucky dial (276091) marks the six it plays.

strategies.name: Hunter Excalibur
strategies.description: The whole board, one lucky dial (976976), six balls — nothing else gets a say.

strategies.name: Hunter Joyeuse
strategies.description: The full board spins past its lucky dial (1055603); six balls stay in the line.

strategies.name: Hunter Durandal
strategies.description: The board never changes and neither does its lucky dial (957889) — six balls per spin.

strategies.name: Hunter Tizona
strategies.description: Its lucky dial (1331464) takes the whole board for a spin before naming six.

strategies.name: Hunter Sovereign
strategies.description: Reigns over the full 1–49 board — its lucky dial (390919) names the six it plays.

strategies.name: Cold Zone Rotation
strategies.description: Hottest decade and coldest decade by 30-draw count; 3 hottest balls from the hot decade + 3 coldest from the cold decade; no-recycle refill from the hottest unblocked rest.

strategies.name: Hollow-Middle Barbell
strategies.description: Pins the lowest ball to the empirical first-position median and the highest to the top of the cage, then hollows out the middle — four balls packed into 36–46 and a line span locked to the modal 43.

strategies.name: Fisher Spectral Harmonic Phase Lock
strategies.description: Ranks the balls by their constructive DFT harmonic phase at the next draw, weighted by Fisher's g-ratio, and requires four distinct tails.

strategies.name: CONSENSUS STACK Rank Fusion
strategies.description: Runs all nine estimators, lets each vote 1.0 down to 0.125 for its top eight, and plays the six balls the whole desk agrees on most.

strategies.name: Root-7 Trio
strategies.description: 3 balls from the digital-root-7 set {7,16,25,34,43} (ensemble-ranked, mask may drop members) + parity-balanced ensemble fills; no consecutive pairs.

strategies.name: Gap-Gradient Construction
strategies.description: Builds the line from gaps upward — one small (1–3), one large (9–14), three medium (4–8) gaps summing to a 33–40 span — matching the empirical delta profile.

strategies.name: Coupon-Collector 49-Ball Sweep Completer
strategies.description: Pairs unseen balls from the active 25-draw sweep with short-term velocity leaders to catch the tail of the cycle.

strategies.name: Max Entropy & Bonus Bridge
strategies.description: Rejects lines until every pairwise difference is unique (AC = 10, the ceiling) while embedding the strongest-lift triplet and all-time frequency leaders, centred on sum 150.

strategies.name: Board Corners
strategies.description: Board corners {1,7,43,49} + ensemble fill.

strategies.name: Hot 40-Draw Streak
strategies.description: Raw hit count over the trailing 40 draws.

strategies.name: Hunter Colossus
strategies.description: Strides the whole board every round; its lucky dial (830513) lands on six.

strategies.name: Hunter Imperium
strategies.description: An empire of one: its lucky dial (490261) rules six balls of the full board.

strategies.name: Hunter Behemoth
strategies.description: The full board under one lucky dial (875141) — six balls, every round.

strategies.name: Tempo Allegro
strategies.description: Fast and bright; its lucky dial (525696) picks six from the full board.

strategies.name: CLUSTER-DENSITY Pair Graph
strategies.description: Greedy seed plus swap search for the six numbers with the densest co-occurrence z-scores across all 1,176 pairs — a set-level objective no per-ball estimator expresses.

strategies.name: One Per Tail Digit
strategies.description: One ball per distinct last digit (mod-10).

strategies.name: Double Consecutive Runs
strategies.description: The two highest-count historical consecutive pairs (e.g. 22-23, 48-49) + 2 ensemble fills.

strategies.name: Sum Regression (OLS)
strategies.description: Ordinary-least-squares fit: next-draw appearance vector regressed on recent-window features (hit rates at lags) — the regression's fitted propensity.

strategies.name: EWMA 20
strategies.description: EWMA of hits with half-life 20 draws.

strategies.name: Residue-4 Line
strategies.description: The residue-4 class {4,13,22,31,40,49} by recency, masked fill.

strategies.name: Rooster Column
strategies.description: The Rooster zodiac column of the Mark-Six board {10, 22, 34, 46} (balls ≡ column mod 12) — members by recency, masked ensemble fill to 6.

strategies.name: Hot–Cold Barbell
strategies.description: 3 hottest + 3 coldest of the last 100 draws.

strategies.name: Hot–Cold Sandwich
strategies.description: Cold,hot,cold,hot,cold,hot — alternate the coldest and hottest balls of the last 100 draws.

strategies.name: Tempo Andante
strategies.description: Unhurried, constant; its lucky dial (421781) walks the board for six.

strategies.name: Halo Expand
strategies.description: Two balls from the ±1 WRAPAROUND halo (1↔49 wrap) of the previous draw, ensemble fill.

strategies.name: LAG-MIX Carry Vote
strategies.description: A harmonic-weighted vote over the last six draws — the previous draw weighs 1, the one before a half — pooling six lags of the thin carry-over effect.

strategies.name: Codex Core + 2
strategies.description: 4-ball codex core (top-4 ensemble) + 2 structural fills inside the sum band.

strategies.name: Board Shift +24
strategies.description: Previous draw's balls +24 (wrap).

strategies.name: I-Ching Hexagram
strategies.description: Hexagram h = (day-of-year − 1) mod 64 + 1; its yang-line ball set from the I-Ching table seeds the line; arithmetic completion ((h + 10k − 1) mod 49 + 1).

strategies.name: Draw-Number Wheel
strategies.description: Seed = draw number mod 49 + 1; ensemble fill.

strategies.name: Twice-in-Five
strategies.description: Indicator of exactly 2 hits in the last 5 draws.

strategies.name: Prime Mirror Twin & Composites
strategies.description: Locks one prime-to-prime mirror twin summing to 50 and bans every other prime, filling the last four slots with high-decade composites.

strategies.name: Skip 12–20 Window
strategies.description: Indicator of current skip ∈ [12,20].

strategies.name: High-Sum Volume Barbell
strategies.description: The anti-quick-pick shape: five balls from the 32–49 range and one calendar ball, with the line's sum held above the crowded mid-sum zone and the wheel's best 7th-ball candidate reserved for the bonus slot.

strategies.name: Tempo Vivace
strategies.description: Lively every round — its lucky dial (1025307) lands six on the board.

strategies.name: Segment Deficit
strategies.description: Segment deficit: for each of 7 board segments, (expected − observed) appearances over the trailing 50 draws, normalised per segment width — load the most under-drawn segment.

strategies.name: Sum Target 135
strategies.description: Sum steered to the 135 band (dense region).

strategies.name: Centre Cross
strategies.description: Center row 4 ∪ column 4 of the 7x7 grid {22,29,36,43, 4,11,18,25,32,39,46} — 6 by recency, masked.

strategies.name: Ganzhi Stem Day-Regime Harmony
strategies.description: Calendar-conditional alignment targeting Monday velocity leaders (18, 23, 34, 39, 47) or Thursday anchors (4, 11, 20, 42, 46).

strategies.name: He-Sum Parity Balance
strategies.description: Compute each candidate ball's digit-sum parity; from the ensemble top pool take the 3 highest odd-digit-sum balls + the 3 highest even-digit-sum balls — the he-sum parity balance.

strategies.name: Hot 4 · Cold 2
strategies.description: Hot-4 + cold-2 blend.

strategies.name: AC Lock 7
strategies.description: AC value (distinct pairwise differences − 5) exactly 7; sum 115-185.

strategies.name: Masked Repeat Echo
strategies.description: Start from the previous draw's exact 6 balls; the no-recycle mask then replaces every one of them with the next-highest ensemble ball — effectively the closest-allowed echo of the last draw.

strategies.name: EWMA 200
strategies.description: EWMA of hits with half-life 200 draws.

strategies.name: Tempo Fortissimo
strategies.description: Plays at full volume — its lucky dial (797215) hammers six out of the board.

strategies.name: Metal Element Set
strategies.description: Metal element set (4,9 stems: {4,9,14,19,24,29,34,39,44,49}), form-ranked.

strategies.name: CUSUM Structural Drift Counter-Tilt
strategies.description: Enforces 3 odd / 3 even parity with modal span (36–44) to correct cumulative sum drift.

strategies.name: Markov Lift (Lag 2)
strategies.description: Lag-2 Markov lift: P(hit | ball hit exactly 2 draws ago).

strategies.name: AC Lock 9
strategies.description: AC exactly 9; sum 115-185.

strategies.name: Tempo Presto
strategies.description: Quick off the dial (262125): full board in, six balls out.

strategies.name: Two-Back Repeats
strategies.description: Balls that hit exactly 2 draws ago (lag-2 repeat candidates).

strategies.name: MACD 12/26/9 Acceleration Crossover
strategies.description: Captures positive MACD histogram divergence where short-term exponential velocity outpaces long-term trend.

strategies.name: EWMA 100
strategies.description: EWMA of hits with half-life 100 draws.

strategies.name: Pair-Affinity Anchor
strategies.description: Anchor one of the top-5 positive-z pairs; fill 4 slots with balls whose pair-z with BOTH anchors lies in [−1,+1] (neutral); ensemble fill the rest.

strategies.name: 4 Odd · 4 High Mix
strategies.description: 4 odd / 4 high.

strategies.name: Longest-Unseen Pair
strategies.description: The consecutive pair longest unseen in the last 200 draws seeds the line; ensemble fill.

strategies.name: 28 Lunar Mansions
strategies.description: The 28 lunar mansions mapped onto 1-49; play the current date's mansion set.

strategies.name: Short-Term Velocity Surfer
strategies.description: Rides the six strongest blended 10- and 50-draw surges (velocity residuals over chance), holding the sum inside the peak 150–179 tier with at least five distinct tail digits.

strategies.name: Geometric Steps
strategies.description: Geometric-progression gaps between sorted picks.

strategies.name: Digit-Sum Ladder
strategies.description: Six balls carrying distinct digit-sums 1,2,3,4,5,6 + ensemble fill.

strategies.name: Cold-Tail Rebound
strategies.description: One ball from each of the 3 most under-drawn tail digits in the last 30 draws + ensemble fill.

strategies.name: Triple Anchor
strategies.description: Seed the top historical triple (count-based, walk-forward); fill 3 to satisfy 5 distinct tails + sum 115-185 + 3odd/3low + ≥5 residues; discard anchor if impossible.

strategies.name: Feng-Shui × FFG
strategies.description: Feng-shui set ∩ skip-band (FFG) filter + ensemble fill.

strategies.name: Pentagonal Numbers
strategies.description: Pentagonal {1,5,12,22,35} + fill.

strategies.name: Codex Parity Picker
strategies.description: From the top-14 ensemble pool pick the 6-ball line maximising ensemble score subject to a target odd-count parity template; if no line matches the parity target, fall back to the plain top-6.

strategies.name: 3-3 Parity Picker
strategies.description: Enumerate C(k,6) from the ensemble's top pool; keep lines with exactly 3 odd / 3 even; pick the highest summed ensemble score.

strategies.name: Second-Difference Zigzag Sawtooth
strategies.description: Demands at least two second-difference sign flips with the net gap curvature held inside ±2.5, reading the multi-horizon velocity leaders.

strategies.name: Date Wheel
strategies.description: Seed = (next draw day + month) mod 49 + 1; ensemble fill.

strategies.name: Lattice ×6
strategies.description: 6-step lattice spacing anchored at frequency leaders.

strategies.name: High Primes
strategies.description: High primes {37,41,43,47} extended by recency ranking.

strategies.name: Induced 6-Node Subgraph & Markov Flow
strategies.description: Greedy plus tournament selection over the fifteen internal pair edges, favouring positive co-occurrence Z and the incoming lag-1 Markov lift.

strategies.name: Dragon Column
strategies.description: The Dragon zodiac column of the Mark-Six board {3, 15, 27, 39} (balls ≡ column mod 12) — members by recency, masked ensemble fill to 6.

strategies.name: Positional Favourites
strategies.description: For each sorted position i=1..6, take the most frequent ball in that position's window (P1:1-14, P2:7-21, P3:14-28, P4:22-36, P5:29-43, P6:36-49) over the last 200 draws; masked.

strategies.name: Multi-Factor 6-Quant Composite Scorecard
strategies.description: Linear combination of RSI-14, 10-draw velocity residual, 50-draw velocity, and long-term frequency.

strategies.name: Quick Pick Control
strategies.description: Seeded uniform random 6-of-49 from balls not in the last draw. The honest chance baseline.

strategies.name: Wilder RSI-14 Momentum Breakout
strategies.description: Harnesses high relative strength (RSI ≥ 54) with a broad 4+ decade spread to avoid cluster clustering.
